TDR Capital | ESG Policy & Principles 6 
TDR is structured to avoid potential conflicts of interest. TDR's primary business is the management of its related private 
equity funds and the portfolio companies within these funds. The firm does not have any separate corporate advisory or 
other related areas of business. 
TDR is a supporter and signatory to the Principles of Responsible Investment, Initiative Climat International and the ESG 
Data Convergence Initiative.
